decisive_items: Histopathologic findings showed plate-like subepidermal tumor extending horizontally under epidermis with multiple cord-like connections to overlying epidermis
Neoplastic cords consisted of clear/pale epithelial cells with cytoplasm showing strong periodic acid-Schiff staining due to glycogen accumulation
response.rationale: Specific histopathologic findings support Eccrine poroma diagnosis

rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathologic findings for Nevus depigmentosus
